purpose: Convert verified implementation and real-use failures into permanent regression requirements.
maintenance_rule: Every newly verified meaningful failure must be corrected at its responsible layer and added here before it is considered closed.
pass_condition: No regression case may violate its invariant. A visually attractive result still fails if the listed contract is broken.
